clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother began lying awake over money in March 1988 and stopped talking with your father about it by May 1988; your brother's grades fell by November 1989; your mother grew calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts in your parents' distance over money and your brother's functioning pile up around this loss, and your mother's ease returning suggests the period settled.

clusters.name: Your mother Della's breast cancer diagnosis, 1993–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother's diagnosis in February 1995, within the following months: you left home for college in September 1993; you developed migraines keeping you in bed by March 1994 and called your brother most nights by April 1994; you stopped returning his calls by June 1995 and stopped calling home by February 1996. Your symptoms and your shifts toward and away from your brother bracket your mother's diagnosis, with your distance from home hardening over the months after it.
